<details>
The provided patch modifies the build script of a Tauri application to prevent downloading a bundled Node.js runtime during the build process when packaged for Arch Linux. Instead, it relies on the system-installed Node.js via the `nodejs` package dependency, which is standard practice in Arch packaging to avoid bloat and maintain consistency with distribution libraries.

This allows upstream to retain the original behavior for macOS/Windows builds while disabling it by default in the Arch package. There is no obfuscation, no unexpected network activity, and no execution of external code.

The patch is a clean, minimal deviation from upstream that aligns with Arch packaging guidelines. It does not introduce any malicious behavior, backdoors, or data exfiltration mechanisms. The logic is transparent and scoped strictly to build-time configuration.
</details>
